description:
One ad's live figures: impressions, clicks, CTR, reach, spend, eCPM, eCPC, hourly.

Returns `totals` and `hourly`.
name: get_ad_stats

creative_id.description: The creative it shows; null for a listing ad

hourly.description: Hour by hour, oldest first; hours with no event are left out

hour_ict.description: The same hour in Vietnam, such as "2026-11-25 15:00 ICT"

reach_new.description: Sessions seen for the first time that UTC day, in that hour

listing_id.description: The advertised listing; null for a creative ad

clicks.description: Clicks and middle clicks on the card, once per browser session per 30 minutes

ctr.description: clicks ÷ impressions (0 to 1); null before any impression

ecpc_usdc.description: Spend per click, in USDC; null before any click

ecpm_usdc.description: Spend per 1,000 impressions, in USDC; null before any impression

frequency.description: impressions ÷ reach; null before any reach

impressions.description: Viewable impressions: at least half the card on screen for one second, once per browser session per 30 minutes

invalid.description: Invalid traffic left out of the figures: bots, prefetches, events outside the run, the per-address cap

paid_usdc.description: The whole price paid, in USDC

reach.description: Browser sessions that saw it, each once per UTC day

spend_usdc.description: The price paid, pro rata to the part of the run that has elapsed, in USDC

updated_at.description: When these figures were read (ISO 8601): live to the last few seconds

title: Get ad figures
